text.reason: an audition plays a scene out loud: its preview says what would sound and hands out a confirmation for the producer to give
text.remediation: Preview it with live_session_audition_preview, show the producer what it will do, then apply it with live_session_audition_apply.

text.reason: launching a clip plays it out loud: its preview says what would sound and hands out a confirmation for the producer to give
text.remediation: Preview it with live_clip_launch_preview, show the producer what it will do, then apply it with live_clip_launch_apply.

text.reason: a capture records what Live plays: its preview says what it would record and hands out a confirmation for the producer to give
text.remediation: Preview it with live_audio_capture_preview, show the producer what it will do, then apply it with live_audio_capture_apply.

text.reason: recording arms tracks and records: the producer starts it having seen what would record
text.remediation: Preview it with live_recording_preview, show the producer what it will do, then apply it with live_recording_apply.

text.reason: arming opens a network channel that moves parameters live: the producer arms it having seen its endpoint and targets
text.remediation: Preview it with live_realtime_arm_preview, show the producer what it will do, then apply it with live_realtime_arm_apply.

text.reason: answering one of Live's dialogs: the producer reads the dialog before its button is pressed
text.remediation: Preview it with live_application_dialog_preview, show the producer what it will do, then apply it with live_application_dialog_apply.

text.reason: pressing a launch button plays out loud: the producer presses it having seen what it launches
text.remediation: Preview it with live_fire_button_preview, show the producer what it will do, then apply it with live_fire_button_apply.
